# @arnaud-zg/configs

> Shareable dev-tooling configs (ESLint, Prettier, tsconfig, tsdown, Lefthook, remark, commitlint)
> published to npm as @arnaud-zg/configs. The Claude Code plugins and Agent Skills that used to live
> here, including the hexagonal-skill-builder linter, moved to arnaud-zg/skills.

## @arnaud-zg/configs: shareable dev-tooling configs

- [README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/README.md): install, security, what's inside
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/docs/tutorial.md)
- [How-to guides](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/docs/how-to.md)
- [Reference](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/docs/reference.md)
- [Explanation](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/docs/explanation.md)

- [arnaud-zg/skills](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills): the marketplace, its plugins and their docs
